meta.description: Grows a leaf by simulating its development: veins grow and carry the margin, new veins appear where the margin got long enough, and the margin resists stretching (Runions, Tsiantis & Prusinkiewicz 2017).

size.description: Scale of the leaf, like the size of the leaf node. The other inputs change its shape but not its length.

age.description: How long the leaf grew. Older leaves have more veins, teeth and lobes.

width.description: 0 = a narrow leaf, 1 = a broad, round one.

teeth.description: 0 = a smooth edge, 1 = deep, sharp teeth.

lobes.description: 0 = no lobes, 1 = a leaf cut into many deep lobes.

vein_density.description: How close together the side veins grow. 0 = a few veins, 1 = many veins with many small teeth, which also makes the leaf broader.

petiole.description: Length of the stalk below the blade. 0 = the blade starts right at the base.

tooth_direction.description: Which way the teeth point. -1 = towards the base, 0 = straight out, 1 = towards the tip.

vein_angle.description: Angle between the side veins and the vein they branch from, in degrees. Small angles give narrow leaves, large ones broad leaves with a pointed outline.

vein_depth.description: How deep the veins are pressed into the blade.

vein_width.description: Width of the midvein, thinner veins get narrower. 0 = as narrow as the resolution allows.

x_curve.description: Fold the leaf along its midrib, in degrees. 0 = flat, 90 = U-shape.

y_curve.description: Curl the leaf upward along its length, in degrees. 0 = flat, 90 = the tip points straight up.

resolution.description: Mesh density, the number of triangles along the length of the leaf.
